QUOTE: Add the `MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME>` define with its negative value in the module's public header... Do not edit `library/error.c`. The build regenerates it.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says to add the define to the public header and not edit error.c, but it never says the define must be /** */-documented, and it is unsure how the generator reads descriptions. The item requires the documented-define mechanism.
